Real macOS CGL driver bridge with shader/program/buffer/texture/framebuffer/renderbuffer objects, matrix/vector/array uniforms, actual texture uploads/readPixels, queried driver strings, native precision-query availability, typed parameter arrays and real binding object identity

Atomic reference-counted, mutex-guarded raster/GL Surface backs Window/Worker OffscreenCanvas with coherent dimensions/pixels/taint, atomic snapshot-and-clear transfer and safe observer teardown; Rust CGL operations are serialized across threads

SessionStorage is owned by stable top-level frame ID plus origin, shared only with same-tab same-origin descendants, preserved across document replacement and cleared on tab/session close; Meta+A/Ctrl+A follows actual platform and UTF16 selection semantics

One Config native Identity owns UA product/version, low/full brands, mobile, platform and architecture declarations; HttpClient baseline headers and both Window/Worker NavigatorUAData read the same active declaration. Default UA is Lightpanda/<actual build version>; explicit custom UA is parsed rather than retaining fixed Lightpanda hints.

Fixed native UA and Client Hint headers are shared by navigation, subresources, fetch, iframe/worker requests and WebSocket upgrades. CLI/CDP/Fetch partial header overrides cannot introduce a second identity; CDP UA overrides replace the full native declaration. Low-entropy brands use major versions; fullVersionList and uaFullVersion use the configured complete product version.

authenticity_source_revision.scope: OpenSpec 7.3 native declarations, functional color/GL controls and genuine font resolution

authenticity_source_revision.tests: Native Identity and RGBA regressions each passed; actual v2 matrix covers Window/iframe/Worker drawing, DSP, GL, declarations and persistence
authenticity_source_revision.migration: Existing persisted UA values are never rewritten. Explicit environment migration selects the new native default. A recognized UA operating system that contradicts resolved.platform is rejected at native identity admission.
authenticity_source_revision.custom_ua: Recognized browser product tokens or the custom first product supply the declared brand/version; UA operating-system tokens and the compatible configured platform supply JS/wire platform. This does not claim another browser's implementation or exact Chrome output equivalence. Malformed product/version syntax is an explicit configuration error; an absent version, unknown platform version and unknown model remain empty.
authenticity_source_revision.rendering_inspection: Window/Worker Canvas uses native retained raster/text surfaces, GL uses actual CGL shaders/textures/readPixels, and OfflineAudioContext pulls real oscillator/AudioParam/gain/connection DSP quanta. Real F1 runs exposed missing DITHER, functional rgba parsing and collapsed generic font families; fixed actual enum 0x0BD0, allocation-free rgb()/rgba() parsing and shared renderer family selection. Native font subset selection now reuses the existing coherent core-font policy. No canned output/noise or error suppression.
